OpenStreetMap contains roughly 15.7 thousand buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 85% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 3 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 0% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months.
